rationale: A privacy-minimized semantic summary is not an exact source-relative evidence span and must not occupy the same canonical object class merely because its own projected representation can be hashed. Canonical evidence_span should retain the invariant that it represents source-bound evidence with an exact locator/excerpt or otherwise verifiable source-relative representation. Privacy minimization is a derivative transformation and should be represented by a separate canonical evidence_projection class, preferably generalized beyond privacy with projection_kind=PRIVACY_MINIMIZED. The projection may reference a source_instance and, when safely available, an evidence_span; it must carry its own representation digest, transformation/fidelity metadata, and explicit raw-source digest state distinguishing WITHHELD_FOR_PRIVACY from UNAVAILABLE_OR_NOT_CAPTURED. A withheld or absent raw digest must never be fabricated. Evidence projections may support scoped semantic claims appropriate to their fidelity, but they cannot satisfy an exact-source-evidence requirement or silently promote a paraphrase into primary evidence. This preserves privacy without weakening the meaning of evidence_span.
